### David Spares Saul Again
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/david-spares-saul-again
Passage: 1 Samuel 26:10-11
Points:
- Despite Saul's earlier pledge to leave David alone, he resumes his pursuit with an army in the wilderness of Ziph.
- David and Abishai enter Saul's camp undetected because the Lord has placed Saul and his troops into a deep sleep.
- David restrains Abishai from killing the sleeping king, refusing to seize the promised throne by violence or personal force.
- David patiently trusts God's timing, confessing that the Lord Himself will remove Saul when the right day comes.
- Believers are reminded that God's sovereign providence directs all circumstances and works faithfully for their ultimate good.
